scene: The open gondola hums as soapy suds float past towering city bricks.
beats: You squeegee the soapy glass clear, spotting a lightning-catcher spire just as the gondola docks at Rainmaker Rooftops and its metal gate swings wide.
The operator coos cheerfully and presses a damp umbrella token into your hand. The cables lock, and the exit doors slide open.
A tiny clockwork frog springs from the glowing green suds straight into your pocket! The gondola jolts to a halt, opening its doors to the mist.
picture: Flat side view inside the narrow yellow gondola floor. Far left, a foam-caked round porthole. Centre-left, the player leans on his prosthetic leg in orange corduroy. Centre, a pigeon-headed operator grips brass levers. Right, a sloshing bucket glows green. Far right, cables rise upward through open air.
shown: a circular glass porthole covered in thick iridescent foam on the far left
a pigeon-headed operator in yellow overalls steering levers at the centre
a sloshing metal pail glowing with strange luminescent green water on the right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the gondola glides past the roof, dodging a rogue cloud puff. At the terminus, you hop into a sputtering sidecar motorbike that zips you straight to Midnight Radio Repair.
after.then: Step off at Midnight Radio Repair

variants.scene: A warm lantern glows while the cozy lift squeaks along its cables.
beats: You scrub away the sparkly froth, glimpse a gleaming spire, and feel the gondola dock at Rainmaker Rooftops as the exit swings wide.
The pigeon conductor gives a soft trill, handing you a damp umbrella token right as the cables clunk and the entryway slides back.
A winding toy frog jumps from the neon broth and lands safely in your pocket while the lift bumps to a gentle, open stop.
variants.ride_on: Riding past the rooftop, you dodge an unruly cloud, hop in a sputtering sidecar motorbike at the end of the line, and zip to Midnight Radio Repair.

variants.scene: Lavender foam drifts across the windows while you ponder {quest}.
beats: Wiping the shimmering bubbles reveals a tall lightning-catcher spire just as the car rattles into Rainmaker Rooftops and opens up.
The operator makes a friendly coo and offers a soggy token for umbrellas. With a hiss of iron cables, the doors pull apart.
A mechanical frog leaps straight out of the sparkling green liquid into your coat, just as the gondola stops and the exit parts.
variants.ride_on: You skip the stop, sail around a puff of cloud, and board a noisy sidecar motorbike at the terminus for a ride to Midnight Radio Repair.

variants.scene: Cables hum overhead as the yellow car rises through the evening chill.
beats: You clear the iridescent lather and spot a lightning spire as the lift clatters into Rainmaker Rooftops, opening its iron grating.
After a gentle bird chirp, the pilot gifts you a wet umbrella token. The pulleys lock tightly, letting the heavy doors slide aside.
Out of the bright green wash jumps a wind-up frog into your pocket, right as the ride halts and reveals the misty air.
variants.ride_on: Floating past the rooftop and ducking a stray cloud, you catch an energetic sidecar motorbike at the final station bound for Midnight Radio Repair.
